title: Chicken and Coconut Curry
blurb: Tender chicken pieces in a fragrant curry sauce with carrots and coconut milk, finished with fresh coriander.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and peel and slice the onion. Peel the carrot and cut into rounds, then peel and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the onion for five minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and curry paste and cook for one minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken pieces and cook for three minutes, turning to coat in the curry paste.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, then add the carrots. Bring to a simmer and cook for fifteen minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the carrots are tender.
Stir in the fish sauce, then roughly chop the coriander and scatter over the top before serving.
